name: Skills page, skill editor, and the agent's Skills tab render the seeded catalogue
description: Loads /skills and confirms the L02 seeded catalogue renders in the rail, then opens pr-quality-rubric and walks its editor tabs. The Preview tab assertion is the important one: it matches the literal '### Skill:' heading, which is what renderSkillBlock emits into the review prompt — so this flow fails if the Preview tab ever drifts from what the run executor actually injects. Finally opens Test Quality Reviewer's Skills tab and confirms its three seeded links. Read-only seeded data (no model call, no review run). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB — run via the hermetic stack (./scripts/e2e.sh), see e2e/README.md.
